snippet.title: Kinki Spiritual Affairs Bureau" Nintendo Switch 2 launches on July 30!
snippet.description:
Following its release on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S in July 2025, "Kinki Spiritual Affairs Bureau" is officially available on Nintendo Switch 2 starting today.
A Japanese-style horror TPS game where you can fight back against the spirits.

◆Nintendo eShop
 https://nintendo.com/us/store/products/kinki-spiritual-affairs-bureau-switch-2
◆AMATA Games "Kinki Spiritual Affairs Bureau"
 https://amata.games/en/game/kinki-spiritual-affairs-bureau/
